meta.description: Clear answers about private lessons, schedules, teachers, progress, and privacy at Noor Al-Wahy Academy.

faq.title: Helpful answers before you begin
faq.description: These are the essentials about learning and follow-up. If your question remains, contact the academy directly.

format.question: Are lessons private or in groups?
format.answer: Lessons are one-to-one, focused on the student’s level, plan, and needs in recitation, memorization, or reading foundations.

schedule.question: How are lesson times shown?
schedule.answer: A weekly time is set and shown in each user’s local timezone, keeping schedules clear across different countries.

teacher.question: How is a teacher selected?
teacher.answer: The academy considers the learning track, availability, and capacity, while matching student and teacher gender under academy policy.

progress.question: How can I follow progress?
progress.answer: Student and family portals show attendance, evaluations, homework, the Quran progress map, and reports approved by the academy.

language.question: Is the experience available in Arabic and English?
language.answer: Yes. The public site and portals support Arabic and English, and language can be switched while keeping the current page.

privacy.question: Who can see student information?
privacy.answer: Information is limited by role and permission. Teachers see only their assigned students, and families see only children linked to their accounts.

more.title: Still have a question?
more.description: Use an official academy channel and we will clarify what you need.
